reason: 5.21.0 lands the 2026-08-11 whole-codebase adversarial review: eight parallel finders, an independent default-refuted skeptic per finding, 24 confirmed defects fixed. Headline is the evidence classifier - a newline instead of &&, or quotes around the binary name, dropped a catastrophic command's grade from 100 to 35/30 and erased every flag - plus idempotent replay that served a prior allow to a different act.
